name: qapps
description: The Amazon Q Apps feature capability within Amazon Q Business allows web experience users to create lightweight, purpose-built AI apps to fulfill specific tasks from within their web experience.

subcommands.name: associate-library-item-review
subcommands.description: Associates a rating or review for a library item with the user submitting the request.

subcommands.name: associate-q-app-with-user
subcommands.description: This operation creates a link between the user's identity calling the operation and a specific Q App.

subcommands.name: batch-create-category
subcommands.description: Creates Categories for the Amazon Q Business application environment instance.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-category
subcommands.description: Deletes Categories for the Amazon Q Business application environment instance.

subcommands.name: batch-update-category
subcommands.description: Updates Categories for the Amazon Q Business application environment instance.

subcommands.name: create-library-item
subcommands.description: Creates a new library item for an Amazon Q App, allowing it to be discovered and used by other allowed users.

subcommands.name: create-presigned-url
subcommands.description: Creates a presigned URL for an S3 POST operation to upload a file.

subcommands.name: create-q-app
subcommands.description: Creates a new Amazon Q App based on the provided definition.

subcommands.name: delete-library-item
subcommands.description: Deletes a library item for an Amazon Q App, removing it from the library so it can no longer be discovered or used by other users.

subcommands.name: delete-q-app
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon Q App owned by the user.

subcommands.name: describe-q-app-permissions
subcommands.description: Describes read permissions for a Amazon Q App in Amazon Q Business application environment instance.

subcommands.name: disassociate-library-item-review
subcommands.description: Removes a rating or review previously submitted by the user for a library item.

subcommands.name: disassociate-q-app-from-user
subcommands.description: Disassociates a Q App from a user removing the user's access to run the Q App.

subcommands.name: export-q-app-session-data
subcommands.description: Exports the collected data of a Q App data collection session.

subcommands.name: get-library-item
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about a library item for an Amazon Q App, including its metadata, categories, ratings, and usage statistics.

subcommands.name: get-q-app
subcommands.description: Retrieves the full details of an Q App, including its definition specifying the cards and flow.

subcommands.name: get-q-app-session
subcommands.description: Retrieves the current state and results for an active session of an Amazon Q App.

subcommands.name: get-q-app-session-metadata
subcommands.description: Retrieves the current configuration of a Q App session.

subcommands.name: import-document
subcommands.description: Uploads a file that can then be used either as a default in a FileUploadCard from Q App definition or as a file that is used inside a single Q App run.

subcommands.name: list-categories
subcommands.description: Lists the categories of a Amazon Q Business application environment instance.

subcommands.name: list-library-items
subcommands.description: Lists the library items for Amazon Q Apps that are published and available for users in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-q-app-session-data
subcommands.description: Lists the collected data of a Q App data collection session.

subcommands.name: list-q-apps
subcommands.description: Lists the Amazon Q Apps owned by or associated with the user either because they created it or because they used it from the library in the past.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags associated with an Amazon Q Apps resource.

subcommands.name: predict-q-app
subcommands.description: Generates an Amazon Q App definition based on either a conversation or a problem statement provided as input.The resulting app definition can be used to call CreateQApp.

subcommands.name: start-q-app-session
subcommands.description: Starts a new session for an Amazon Q App, allowing inputs to be provided and the app to be run.

subcommands.name: stop-q-app-session
subcommands.description: Stops an active session for an Amazon Q App.This deletes all data related to the session and makes it invalid for future uses.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates tags with an Amazon Q Apps resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Disassociates tags from an Amazon Q Apps resource.

subcommands.name: update-library-item
subcommands.description: Updates the library item for an Amazon Q App.

subcommands.name: update-library-item-metadata
subcommands.description: Updates the verification status of a library item for an Amazon Q App.

subcommands.name: update-q-app
subcommands.description: Updates an existing Amazon Q App, allowing modifications to its title, description, and definition.

subcommands.name: update-q-app-permissions
subcommands.description: Updates read permissions for a Amazon Q App in Amazon Q Business application environment instance.

subcommands.name: update-q-app-session
subcommands.description: Updates the session for a given Q App sessionId.

subcommands.name: update-q-app-session-metadata
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration metadata of a session for a given Q App sessionId.
